mtion.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot notices that mtion studio is open and answering. Cuebot checks by asking it every few seconds.

mtion.disconnected.description: Runs when mtion studio stops answering, for example when you close it.

variables.reason: Why it was marked as closed

mtion.clubhouseChanged.description: Runs when you open a different clubhouse (a project) in mtion studio.

fields.clubhouse: Only react to these clubhouses, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any clubhouse.

variables.mtion.clubhouse.name: The name of the clubhouse that is open now
variables.mtion.clubhouse.id: The id of the clubhouse that is open now
variables.mtion.oldClubhouse.name: The name of the clubhouse that was open before
variables.mtion.oldClubhouse.id: The id of the clubhouse that was open before

mtion.triggerSent.description: Runs right after Cuebot successfully sends an external trigger to mtion studio with a "Send trigger" step. It does not hear triggers that mtion sends by itself.

fields.trigger: Only react to these triggers, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any trigger.

variables.mtion.trigger.name: The name of the trigger that was sent
variables.mtion.trigger.parameters: The values that were sent with it, as raw text

mtion.sendTrigger.description: Fires an external trigger in mtion studio, for example to make your avatar celebrate. The trigger must exist in the clubhouse that is open.

fields.trigger: The external trigger's name (or id) from the open clubhouse, like "Confetti".
fields.parameters: Extra values the trigger takes, one per line as name=value, like "Amount=5". Use the parameter's name or its number (0, 1, ...). For a list-type value, give the option number, starting at 0. Leave empty for none.

variables.mtion.trigger.found: True if a trigger with that name exists in the open clubhouse
variables.mtion.trigger.sent: True if mtion accepted the trigger
variables.mtion.trigger.name: The trigger's name

mtion.getActiveClubhouse.description: Finds out which clubhouse (project) is open in mtion studio and keeps its details for later steps.

variables.mtion.clubhouse.found: True if a clubhouse is open
variables.mtion.clubhouse.name: The clubhouse's name

mtion.getTriggers.description: Reads the list of external triggers in the open mtion clubhouse and keeps it for later steps.

variables.mtion.triggerNames: All trigger names, separated by commas
variables.mtion.triggers: The full list with parameters, as raw text
